subject: Finova - Decision criteria: SLA/latency/deployment follow-up
messages:
From: David Li <david.li@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finova.com>
Date: 2027-01-03T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo - follow-up / clarification

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today - it was helpful. A couple quick follow-ups from our side as we put together the internal decision doc:

- Can you confirm typical p95 latency we should expect for ~256-token prompts under a Dedicated capacity pilot?
- What's the deployment path if we need VPC/private deployment vs hosted (timing / lead time)?
- What SLA levels do you support (uptime and latency SLOs) and how do you handle fallbacks?

Also - procurement will want to know the exact documents we need for the RFX (SOC 2, network diagram, sample SLA). I'm looping procurement on this thread (procurement@finova.com) for visibility.

Appreciate any detail you can share so we can set expectation internally.

Best,
David
Director, Product
Finova

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Li <david.li@finova.com>
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finova.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-04T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo - follow-up / clarification

Hi David - thanks for the notes and for looping procurement. Quick summary and proposed next steps below:

Summary of decision criteria we heard on the call:
- Latency: target p95 requirement (you mentioned) - please confirm threshold.
- Cost: pilot budget vs long-term per-token economics.
- Deployment mode: you indicated a preference for private/VPC for production.
- SLA: uptime target + latency SLOs and fallbacks (canary to hosted model if private node fails).

Quick answers:
- Dedicated pilot: on our Dedicated pools you should expect p95 latencies in the ~150\u2013300ms range for 256-token typical requests depending on model and batching - we can run a small perf test with a representative prompt set to confirm.
- Deployment timing: Hosted API = immediate. Dedicated reserved capacity = ~2\u20134 weeks provisioning for a pilot. Private (VPC) deployment = ~4\u20138 weeks depending on network approvals and KMS integration.
- SLA: we support SLA tiers up to 99.95% for Dedicated; standard hosted SLA is 99.9%. We also provide latency SLOs and automatic fallbacks to hosted variants in cross-region routing.

Requested items for procurement/security: SOC 2 Type II, network diagram, sample SLA (attached draft).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the p95 latency threshold you need so we can run targeted perf tests.
2) Procurement call - propose Jan 14 or Jan 15 to go through RFx items (procurement + security).
3) We'll provide a pilot cost estimate and an initial network diagram + SLA draft.

I've attached a sample SLA and network diagram for procurement to review. I cc'd Rishi (AM) and Monica (security) to help on commercial and compliance items.

Thanks \u2014
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finova_SLA_requirements_v1.pdf, network_diagram.png

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Li <david.li@finova.com>
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: 2027-01-05T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo - follow-up / clarification

Thanks Marissa - helpful summary. Couple clarifications from our side:

- Economic buyer / decision owner: it's me (Sara) for this initial pilot, with procurement running RFx for the enterprise contract.
- Latency targets: for our front-end conversational flows we need p95 < 300ms for ~256-token requests; for batch/async jobs we care more about throughput and cost.
- Deployment mode: we prefer Private (VPC) for production because of PII handling; pilot can run on Dedicated in our cloud account if that shortens time-to-test.
- SLA: minimum 99.9% uptime required. For latency SLOs we'd like an agreed p95 target and escalation path (alerts + runbook).

Procurement asks: please share SOC 2 Type II, a network diagram, and a draft SLA. We will start the RFx next week - procurement@finova.com will send an initial checklist shortly.

Thanks,
Sara Thompson
Head of Product
Finova

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finova.com>, David Li <david.li@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo - follow-up / clarification

Sara / David - great, thanks for confirming. Follow-up with concrete items below so procurement/security can proceed:

Perf & latency commitments (pilot):
- On Dedicated reserved capacity using our recommended model variants, we expect p95 <= 250ms for 256-token interactive requests in a single-region configuration. We'll validate with a short perf run using your representative prompt set (we can spin the test within 3 business days once we have the prompt corpus).

Deployment & timing:
- Pilot path (recommended): Dedicated reserved capacity in your cloud account (or our Dedicated with VPC peering) - ~2\u20133 weeks to provision pilot nodes.
- Production path: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed control plane (4\u20138 weeks, dependent on KMS and networking approvals).

SLA & fallbacks:
- We offer 99.9% (hosted) and up to 99.95% (Dedicated + premium) uptime SLAs.
- Latency SLOs are contractual (we publish p95 targets per route) and we provide automated fallback to a compatible hosted model variant in case of private node outage.

Commercial ballpark (pilot):
- Expected committed pilot cost: ~$4,000\u20136,000/month for reserved Dedicated capacity (depends on model family and throughput).
- Hosted pay-as-you-go remains available for burst/backup and lower up-front.

I've attached: 1) sample SLA draft, 2) network diagram, and 3) link to SOC 2 evidence (we can provide formal report under NDA).

Next actions:
- David / Sara: confirm p95 threshold (you indicated <300ms - note we can target <=250ms for pilot).
- Procurement: please send RFx/checklist and proposed times for Jan 14/15 procurement call.
- Security: Monica, can you add any additional docs Finova will need for the RFx?

Thanks \u2014 we'll prepare a short perf run once we get the prompt set.

Best,
Marissa
Redwood Inference
